purpose: Define WebSocket connection/channel lifecycle, subscriptions and message routing separately from protocol instance and application resource identities.

topics.name: WebSocket Channel Lifecycle
topics.purpose: Define WebSocket connection/channel lifecycle, subscriptions and message routing separately from protocol instance and application resource identities.

semantics.connection_rule: Each connection/session has transient runtime identity.
semantics.target_rule: Published/subscribed messages map to exact canonical resources/events/operations according to binding.
semantics.payload_rule: Received payload is inert until validated/routed.
semantics.auth_rule: Authentication/authorization context is explicit per connection/request where required.
semantics.identity_rule: Connection/channel identity never replaces semantic resource identity.

invariants.rule: Protocol identity, named listener instance, route/address/channel binding and domain operation identity remain separate; protocol exposure never creates semantic ownership or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: connection id becomes semantic resource identity

references.purpose: WebSocket channels bind to exact resources.
